commit.message:
[DEVOPS] update DevOps files (#27)

* update ignore files

* updated CODEOWNERS and labeler

* update workflows to v.2.1.13

* fix K8s HPA deprecation warning

* update helm ignore

* fix set-output deprecation warning

* add dependabot config

* fix GITHUB OUTPUT typo

* update PR bypass ignored paths

* update paths ignore in PR workflow

* specify secrets file in AKS deploy paths ignore

* update PR labeler github action version

* update workflow names

* add workflow linter

* remove paths ignore

* add additional dependabot configs

* renamed lint step

* remove dependabot gh actions versioning strategy

* fix double asterisk in helm ignore

* change file extension to .yml

* add git attributes file

* updated workflow triggers

* rename br bypass

* rename pr labels

* syncing up with dotnet template

* syncing up template repos

* Apply prettier changes

* syncing with other template repos

* Apply prettier changes

* update workflows to 2.1.15

* rename nextjs ci test workflow

* added docker dependabot config

* update codeowners file action versions

* added GC ui workflows

* update deployment and versioning in readme

* Apply prettier changes

* add job names to AKS deploy

* add dev tools to paths ignore

* specified pr limit + day of week dependabot config

* fixed up label config

* simplified workflow triggers

* added release yaml

* renamed ci test to be more generic

* removed unnecessary pr bypass

* added auto approve dependabot prs

* use github token for pr labels repo token

* added pr clean cache workflow

* remove auto approve dependabot workflow

* update actions based off GC UI

* add back dependabot automation config

---------

Co-authored-by: ebronson68 <ebronson68@users.noreply.github.com>
